selected_script.angle: The satisfying process of chemical lifting followed by effortless stand-up sweeping that removes deep grime from a high-traffic tile path
selected_script.hook: Have you ever noticed that one high-traffic tile path in your house getting darker and darker? Dirt just gets packed in there.

script_record.segment_01: Have you ever noticed that one high-traffic tile path in your house getting darker and darker? Dirt just gets packed in there.
script_record.segment_02: I applied this professional-strength grout cleaner and let it sit. Then, using this V-shaped brush on a pole, I scrubbed without ever getting on my knees.
script_record.segment_03: The twisted bristles reach deep into the lines without scratching. I just mopped it away, and the grout looks totally brand new again.
